title: Handle unavailable browser storage during cold workspace bootstrap
outcome: Parent-confirmed pre-existing limitation from consolidated review6464/6465: main.tsx:27 calls getStoredWorkspaceLayout at module evaluation; workspace-storage.ts:126 reads window.localStorage unguarded; createInitialWorkspaceBootstrap:57 repeats the getter. If access throws before React mounts, no recovery-marker hydration error UI can run. Six-file b8f3eaaa patch handles later marker reads only and does NOT introduce this cold-start failure. No browser-specific settings matrix reproduced; do not claim all private modes fail. Design an explicit non-destructive startup-unavailable state, preserve unknown recovery authority (do not treat read failure as empty and overwrite), cover getter/getItem denial before bootstrap, and clearly bound docs. Search storage/localStorage/bootstrap/workspace recovery found no matching dedicated item; related tm-95c7 documents exclusion, not implementation. Implementation not authorized by this review, no source edits.
